description: Fact-check rental listing claims for a building by BBL. Returns a verdict computed from city records for each claim type: pest_free, great_heat, lead_safe, family_friendly, dry_no_mold, fire_safe, well_maintained, responsive_management, plus the evidence counts behind each verdict. Copy verdicts exactly; never change them.

configuration.query:
FROM hpd_violations, evictions METADATA _index
| WHERE bbl == ?bbl
| EVAL d = TO_UPPER(novdescription), is_v = CASE(_index == "hpd_violations", 1, 0), is_e = CASE(_index == "evictions", 1, 0)
| EVAL p = CASE(d LIKE "*MICE*" OR d LIKE "*RODENT*" OR d LIKE "*RATS*" OR d LIKE "*ROACH*" OR d LIKE "*VERMIN*" OR d LIKE "*BEDBUG*" OR d LIKE "*PEST*", 1, 0), h = CASE(d LIKE "*HEAT*" OR d LIKE "*HOT WATER*", 1, 0), l = CASE(d LIKE "*LEAD*", 1, 0), w = CASE(d LIKE "*WINDOW GUARD*", 1, 0), m = CASE(d LIKE "*MOLD*" OR d LIKE "*LEAK*", 1, 0), f = CASE(d LIKE "*SMOKE DETECT*" OR d LIKE "*CARBON MONOXIDE*" OR d LIKE "*FIRE*", 1, 0)
| STATS pest_violations = SUM(p), heat_violations = SUM(h), lead_paint_violations = SUM(l), window_guard_violations = SUM(w), mold_or_leak_violations = SUM(m), fire_safety_violations = SUM(f), open_hazardous_violations = SUM(is_v), evictions = SUM(is_e), oldest_open_violation = MIN(inspectiondate), apartments = MAX(units)
| EVAL yrs = DATE_DIFF("day", TO_DATETIME("2017-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"), NOW()) / 365.25, years_oldest_open = ROUND(DATE_DIFF("day", oldest_open_violation, NOW()) / 365.25, 1)
| EVAL vpa = ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(open_hazardous_violations) / apartments, 2), epy = ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(evictions) * 100.0 / apartments / yrs, 2)
| EVAL pest_free = CASE(pest_violations > 0, "FALSE", "TRUE"), great_heat = CASE(heat_violations > 0, "FALSE", "TRUE"), lead_safe = CASE(lead_paint_violations > 0, "FALSE", "TRUE"), family_friendly = CASE(lead_paint_violations > 0 OR window_guard_violations > 0, "FALSE", "TRUE"), dry_no_mold = CASE(mold_or_leak_violations > 0, "FALSE", "TRUE"), fire_safe = CASE(fire_safety_violations > 0, "FALSE", "TRUE"), well_maintained = CASE(vpa >= 0.2 OR years_oldest_open > 2, "FALSE", open_hazardous_violations > 0, "MOSTLY TRUE", "TRUE"), responsive_management = CASE(epy >= 1.0 OR years_oldest_open > 2, "FALSE", evictions > 0, "MOSTLY TRUE", "TRUE")
| KEEP pest_free, great_heat, lead_safe, family_friendly, dry_no_mold, fire_safe, well_maintained, responsive_management, pest_violations, heat_violations, lead_paint_violations, window_guard_violations, mold_or_leak_violations, fire_safety_violations, open_hazardous_violations, apartments, vpa, evictions, epy, years_oldest_open
